text:
Sophie Park: quick RFC — putting together a tight launch plan for console telemetry (dashboards / traces / error analysis / retention). want to align on must-have metrics, retention targets, and stakeholder signoffs this quarter. thoughts?
Ajay Rao: +1. need to be explicit about sampling and ingestor cost caps. we can't ship full-trace retention at 30d for everything.
Kevin Lin: agree. propose defaults: traces: 7d full, 30d aggregated span-level; logs/metrics: 14d; dashboards meta/events: 90d. can tune per-customer via plan.
Darren Ortiz: that default set seems reasonable. for SLA gating, we should require: 1) end-to-end latency <250ms for dashboard queries at p95 on small date ranges, 2) trace search response <500ms p95, 3) retention billing estimate validated.
Maria Gomez: design input — dashboard UX needs a quick-query mode for sampled traces and a deep mode that indicates sampling. add a badge: "sampled view" so customers understand partial coverage.
Sophie Park: good — let's draft acceptance criteria: *Must*: basic per-route latency+cost dashboard, trace waterfall with sampling indicator, error grouping w/ top 10 causes, retention controls in UI. *Nice-to-have*: adaptive sampling suggestions, cross-service dependency map.
Ajay Rao: technical constraints: adaptive sampling requires runtime hooks — we can do a 1.0 stateless sampler and add adaptive in v1.1. also need a migration plan for existing KV cache of traces.
observability-bot: deploy-job #obs-ingest-v2 started by @ajay  — build 98 -> staging passed.
Kevin Lin: rollout plan idea: internal alpha (eng + SE) for 2 weeks -> early access with 3 customers -> GA. Must have rollback if ingestion cost delta > 15%.
Darren Ortiz: canary metrics to monitor during alpha: tokens per minute for ingest, p95 query latency, unique trace count, storage growth rate. set alerts at 2x baseline for any of these.
Elaine Chen: docs/devex ask: need a short quickstart + sample queries and a billing explainer. I can draft templates if we lock retention tiers and UI labels.
Sophie Park: timeline proposal: week 1 finish acceptance criteria doc, week 2 engineering spike for sampling+ingest, week 3 internal alpha, week 5 early access, week 8 GA. is that realistic?
Ajay Rao: spike will show whether we can hit the latency gates with current kernels. if not, push GA to week 10.
Maria Gomez: I can prototype the sampling badge and the retention control UI in 3 days once labels are final.
Kevin Lin: also need product/legal signoff for per-customer retention overrides (enterprise feature). I'll loop in legal.
Sophie Park: action items: @Ajay - spike on sampler + ingest cost projection (due +5 days). @Maria - UI badge + retention control mockups (+3 days). @Elaine - quickstart draft (+7 days). @Kevin - legal + plan for enterprise overrides (+7 days). I'll consolidate acceptance criteria doc and post updated thread.
Darren Ortiz: one more: add a hard stop in rollout plan — if cost delta > 15% or error rate increases by >1% absolute, automatically revert to older ingester.
Sophie Park: agreed. Also let's add KPI mapping to OKRs: OKR-Obs-1 reduce mean query latency by 30%, OKR-Obs-2 limit telemetry unit cost growth to <10% at launch.
Ajay Rao: noted. will include estimated infra delta in spike.
observability-bot: alert muted for deploy-job #obs-ingest-v2 for 2h per request from @Sophie Park.
Kevin Lin: thanks — I'll coordinate early access customers: two SaaS startups and one enterprise with Dedicated tier.
Maria Gomez: quick ask — for the error grouping UX, do we want automated fingerprinting or manual rules first? automated seems higher impact for GA.
Sophie Park: automated fingerprinting for GA, with manual override for enterprise. add to acceptance criteria.
Elaine Chen: I'll prepare a short "what's changed" email for customers and a changelog entry. need final copy 48h before GA.
Sophie Park: thanks team. I'll update the doc and tag you all when ready. If nobody objects, we'll lock defaults (7d traces / 30d aggregated / 14d logs) and move forward with the spike. :thumbsup:
